other_conditions: Minimum ten years of work experience and currently engaged in the barber profession
Preference for shops with seating capacity less than three
Preference for applicants registered under LSGDs
Preference for applicants having two daughters
At least one beneficiary must be selected from each Panchayat
If more than 1,000 eligible applications, beneficiaries will be limited to 1,000
Eligibility category noted in source: Other Backward Communities
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹25,000 (50 % of project cost) grant for modernising traditional barbershops, disbursed in up to two installments.
